articles.title: Tambaram Corporation Commissioner put on compulsory wait after tender ‘violation’
articles.description: Tambaram Corporation Commissioner suspended after tender violations; new commissioner appointed amid calls for criminal investigation.

articles.title: Uttar Pradesh: Yogi Cabinet Approves ₹300 Crore To Develop 14,429 Government Primary Schools As Smart Schools
articles.description: The Yogi Cabinet approved ₹300 crore to develop 14,429 Uttar Pradesh government primary schools as Smart Schools. Shreetron India Limited will execute the project through competitive tendering, with smart classes established in phases. The initiative aims to expand digital education and provide children with modern, technology-based learning facilities.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu govt shunts out IAS officer over alleged tender irregularities, placed on compulsory wait
articles.description: Tamil Nadu government transfers Tambaram Corporation Commissioner S Balachander IAS to compulsory wait after anti-corruption NGO Arappor Iyakkam alleged Rs 45.9 lakh tender irregularities. The swift action follows CM C Joseph Vijay’s zero-tolerance pledge against corruption in governance.
